summary: We created a game where players design a space mission and manage resources. They learn about space, engineering, and decision-making in a fun way.
details: Our project is an interactive game where players create and manage a space mission. They choose a spacecraft and resources to complete their mission. It helps students learn about space and engineering. Our goal is to make learning fun and creative. We considered teamwork, resources, and mission success while developing our project.
